artifacts.summary: Confirms convergence-on-activation already works (verified empirically), finds the between-activations detector already exists (nvim repo check g) or is already planned (task 142 Phase 2), narrows this task's remaining scope to the _SAPIENCE_NOTE enforced-key fix, and records a 141->142 dependency edge added during research.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 141 to create an implementation plan scoped to the _SAPIENCE_NOTE enforced-key addition in modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix; coordinate with task 142's landing before finalizing any _SAPIENCE_NOTE text referencing the opt-out/guard layers.

memory_candidates.content: home.activation.claudeSettings's enforced-key reduce step (modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix) fully resets '.hooks' to source on every home-manager switch, verified empirically with a synthetic jq replay against the measured 3-vendor-hook live state -- jq's '*' does not merge arrays and the reduce step overwrites the key wholesale, so vendor hook reinjection is already stripped at every switch; the only gap was the non-enforced _SAPIENCE_NOTE key.

Sapience vendor hook reinjection detection is split across three sites by design: nvim repo's verify-sapience-mcp.sh check (g) is the manual/on-demand detector (already shipped, task 636); task 142's planned sapienceHooksGuard home.activation entry (ordered entryBefore claudeSettings) is the automatic/every-switch detector; dotfiles.nix's claudeSettings enforced-key reset is the switch-time backstop. A new task touching this territory should check all three before adding a fourth.
